editorial:
Imagine being a total mess of a person and then waking up to find out you are pregnant with an alien baby. That is exactly what happens to our main girl in this wild ride. You will love how the movie balances scary monster moments with jokes that actually land. The dynamic between the daughter and her mum is the best part, especially since the mum just cannot stop telling everyone her business while the lead is trying to hide a glowing stomach. It feels like a weird dream that you just cannot stop watching because the situation gets more ridiculous every ten minutes.

The acting is spot on, and the pacing keeps you on your toes without feeling too rushed. While some of the CGI looks a bit cheap in a few scenes, it actually adds to the campy comedy vibe. If you are into movies that make you laugh and jump at the same time, you need to see this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the gross alien details, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final act, the baby is not actually a monster but a scout for a peaceful planet. The twist is that the useless baby daddy was actually a shapeshifting alien agent trying to steal the child back. After a big fight in the kitchen, the mum helps her daughter defeat him. The baby is born and immediately flies back to space, leaving the lead finally free to start her life over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sci-fi comedies and awkward family drama.
